summary: France localization of Business Central 29. It covers payment management with payment slips, RIB bank keys, the FEC tax audit export, fiscal period and year closing, accelerated (derogatory) depreciation, French sales invoice details (SIREN, VAT paid on debits), DEB Intrastat and service declarations, and French ledger reports.
overview:
The French layer adds a large payment management module (payment classes, statuses, steps, slips, archives, addresses) with its own tables, pages and codeunits. It also adds RIB key and agency code fields on bank accounts, FEC export for tax audits, and fiscal closing of accounting periods and years. Learn documents these under "France local functionality", "Payment Management [FR]", "Fiscal Periods and Fiscal Years (FR)" and "Export entries for tax audits".

Other additions are accelerated depreciation (derogatory fields on depreciation books, FA posting groups and posting codeunits), delayed unrealized VAT posting, G/L entry application (Letter fields), and the SIREN/SIRET company identifiers. Sales invoice reports gain French text such as VAT paid on debits and goods versus services. Local trial balance, journal and ledger reports serve French accounting standards. Intrastat (DEB) and service declarations are extended through table and page extensions.

Learn also lists e-invoicing with UBL 2.1 and Factur-X and E-Reporting FR. Learn says these come through extensions, and the code summary shows no objects for them. Some local features are moving to an extensions model, and Learn marks G/L entry application as being deprecated.
key_points: Payment management: payment classes, statuses, steps, slips, archives and payment addresses, with SEPA and export via report or XMLport steps.
RIB key, agency code and RIB checked fields on Bank Account, Customer Bank Account and Vendor Bank Account, with codeunit 10801 "RIB Key".
FEC export for tax audits through the audit file export framework, with opening balances and a Detailed Balance field on G/L accounts.
Fiscal closing: Fiscally Closed and Fiscal Closing Date on accounting periods, reopening of periods, and Posting Allowed From/To in General Ledger Setup.
Accelerated depreciation: derogatory fields on Depreciation Book, FA Depreciation Book and FA Posting Group, plus derogatory posting in the FA codeunits.
SIREN No. on Customer, Vendor and Contact; SIRET No., APE code, legal form and trade register on Company Information; VAT Paid on Debits on sales documents.
Local reports: G/L Journal, Journals, trial balances, detail trial balances for G/L, customers and vendors, and GL/Cust. ledger reconciliation.
DEB Intrastat (obligation level, CISD) and French service declaration setup.

areas.what: Adds RIB key, agency code and RIB checked fields to bank accounts, and a large payment management module of own codeunits, enums and pages for classes, statuses, steps, slips and archives. SEPA direct debit check gets a new event, and the Check report gets French amount-to-text procedures.
areas.why: Learn describes payment slips, classes and steps for bills of exchange, electronic payments and checks, with payment files sent to the bank.

areas.what: Adds FEC audit file export, fiscal year closing, G/L entry application, French account schedules, and local journals and trial balances. Gen. Jnl.-Post Line gains delayed unrealized VAT and derogatory posting procedures, and journal tables get new fields.
areas.why: Learn says the FEC export serves French tax audits, and that G/L entry application justifies balances on asset and liability accounts.

areas.what: Implements accelerated (derogatory) depreciation with new fields on depreciation books, FA depreciation books, posting groups and ledger entries. Disposal, ledger entry insertion and posting codeunits gain derogatory procedures, and there are French professional tax and projected value reports.
areas.why: Learn says accelerated depreciation posts the difference between tax and accounting depreciation books as required by French tax authorities.

areas.what: Adds SIREN No. and payment reporting fields to customers, RIB fields to customer bank accounts, and VAT Paid on Debits to sales headers. Sales invoice and credit memo reports get French text procedures, and new pages and a table link shipments with invoices.
areas.why: Learn describes French invoice information such as SIREN numbers, VAT paid on debits and goods versus services determination.

areas.what: Extends the Intrastat report for the French Declaration of Trade in Goods with an obligation level enum, filter codeunits and page and table extensions. Adds Shipment Method Code to item ledger and journal lines.
areas.why: Learn explains the DEB setup, including CISD, obligation levels and transaction specification filters.

areas.what: Adds SIREN No., payment in progress and payment reporting exclusion to vendors and templates, RIB fields to vendor bank accounts, and French vendor journal and trial balance reports.

Company Information gains French identifiers (SIRET, APE code, legal form, trade register, stock capital, CISD) with SIRET validation. Accounting Period gains fiscal close and reopen procedures, and Country/Region gets a SEPA Allowed field.
areas.why: Learn describes fiscal closing of periods and years that blocks further G/L posting.

areas.what: Holds the France upgrade codeunits and upgrade tags, the Employee Marital Status enum, the FR-PMS permission set and a source code table extension.
Adds local service declaration management and export codeunits, with setup and wizard page extensions and a permission set extension.
Changes the LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets for the French objects.
Adds trade register, APE code, legal form, stock capital and SIREN No. to Contact, with procedures that keep the customer SIREN in sync.
Adds a France-specific expense event subscriber codeunit.
Adds a Marital Status field to Employee.

issues: Overview says Intrastat (DEB) and service declarations are extended through table and page extensions. That is true for Intrastat. Service declarations show only page extensions, codeunits and a permission set extension, with no table extensions.

Overview says the payment management module has its own tables. The code summary counts 28 added tables, but the object list shown stops before any payment tables. The claim is plausible but cannot be checked by name.
Key point 4 uses the code field names Posting Allowed From/To. Learn calls them Allow Posting From/To. Both names are accurate for their own source.
